audit.why: 56.27% over 622 games with a strong Talon early and hard Anivia outscale is exactly what the layers describe: bully 1-5, respect 6+, convert to roams.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly claims Anivia has 'no egg pre-6' (whys[0], whys[3], spikes[0], early, wants.you[0]). Rebirth is her passive and exists from level 1 — Riot's text has no level condition.
audit.why: Kit P text: 'Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health' — unconditional. The real early edge is that the egg is frail and long-cooldown early, not absent.
audit.corrected: All five spots rewritten to 'frail egg' framing at matched length; the 6 flip re-attributed to Glacial Storm zoning plus a tankier egg.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; Crystallize's 17s cooldown (the wall that denies Talon Q leap) unstated; Flash Frost's 11s rank-1 cooldown unstated.
audit.why: Kit: Q cd 11/10/9/8/7, W cd 17, E cd 4, R cd 4/3/2. Wall is terrain — it blocks Talon's Q dash; Talon E vaults player-made terrain contexts are not asserted (not in kit text).
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with 11s Q and 17s W numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 14 lint findings: 12 misgenderings (Anivia called he/his), 2 copy-paste bleeds, cooldowns without a digit.
audit.why: Deterministic lint; anivia is she/her in champ-gender.js.
